title: xtask: the test scanner counts braces inside string literals, so gate test misses tests and quick picks the wrong fn

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:medium
labels.description: One module or crate, a known pattern (issue-worker-medium)

body:
What happens: `cargo xtask gate test <name>` reports `no #[test] fn matches '<name>'` for a test that exists, and the quick tier can attribute a changed test to the wrong function.

Repro on upstream/main (any OS):

```
cargo xtask gate test the_library_folder_is_the_override_else_a_sibling_of_machines --dry-run
# no #[test] fn matches 'the_library_folder_is_the_override_else_a_sibling_of_machines'
cargo xtask gate test a_bad_library_is_refused_whole_by_name --dry-run
# ok - 1 step
```

Cause: `xtask/src/scan.rs` `test_fns` finds each test's end by counting `{` and `}` characters on every line, including those inside string and char literals. In `crates/app/tests/fixture_library.rs`, `a_bad_library_is_refused_whole_by_name` (line 78) calls `refuse("{", "bad JSON")`. The unbalanced `{` in that string keeps the depth above zero past the test's real closing brace, so its span swallows the next test, `the_library_folder_is_the_override_else_a_sibling_of_machines` (line 111). That test never appears in the scan.

Effects:
- `gate test <name>` cannot run the swallowed test, by name or substring, with or without `--exact`/`--binary`.
- The quick tier picks "the changed #[test] fns of a changed suite" from these spans. A diff inside the swallowed test is attributed to the test before it, so quick can run `--exact` on the wrong fn and report green without running the changed test. (Seen on PR #761: quick reported `app fixture_library (1 fn)` ok while the changed test was the swallowed one.)

Fix direction: skip `{`/`}` inside string literals (`"..."`, with `\"` escapes), raw strings (`r"..."`, `r#"..."#`), char literals (`'{'`) and `//` comments when counting depth. Pin it with an xtask unit test whose fixture has a test containing `"{"` followed by a second test that must be found with the right span.

Done means: both repro commands find their test; the new xtask unit test pins a brace-in-string fixture; the quick tier attributes a change in the second test to the second test.
